hooks.command: python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.loki/loki.py" protect --harness codex || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: hook command failed' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.loki/loki.py" context --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" --event SessionStart || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: context unavailable' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.loki/loki.py" hook --harness codex || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: hook command failed' >&2; exit 2; }
